body.opens: A commit puts a holon in every store whose wholes hold it, so a held part lies in the store of the whole that holds it, and what a holon only points to lies in its store or the stores it stands on; a read could ask there first, and every store only for what is found nowhere else.
restsOn: Divergence marked where it arises, so that a read no longer asking every store is not silent about a copy kept elsewhere; it waits on the thread Where divergence is marked.

name: Reading where holding says a holon is
